content: PT-BR technical-writing reference landscape: Novo Manual da Redacao da Folha (classic style reference incl. estrangeirismo rules; official Folha online edition unstable, book is canonical); Manual de Redacao e Estilo do Estadao (Eduardo Martins, 3rd ed. PDF widely available); Microsoft Writing Style Guide is EN-only (pt-br URL serves EN content) BUT Microsoft publishes per-language Localization Style Guides + Terminology collections (.tbx) + UI string search via the Globalization language-resources hub on Microsoft Learn; Google developer documentation style guide has no official pt-BR edition (Write for a global audience page is EN). UFBA academic style manual (Lubisco) as academic complement.
